outcome: The existing approved update completed automatically after the Free executor woke; no new approval or operation was created.

diagnosis.observed: Normal graceful Free-service shutdown after an approximately 15-minute idle gap, followed by a cold new instance. The queued update had not reached generation or the browser during the delay.
diagnosis.inference: This matches Render Free idle spin-down/wake behavior; the long UI-fix gap allowed the executor to sleep. Queue/notification/wake time caused the observed delay, rather than generation latency.

requiredDemoPreparation: Request authenticated executor browser readiness and web/API/portal readiness immediately before the live demo.
After any 15-minute pause or long build gap, warm readiness again before approving or continuing the same case.
Keep durable state in Atlas; do not rely on Free instance memory or filesystem surviving idle restart.
Allow an actual cold wake to complete; do not repeat resident approval or create a replacement operation.
